products.name: Promptfoo
products.note: Open-source prompt testing and red-teaming; declarative YAML test cases with deterministic assertions and LLM-graded checks; CI-first

profile_text.body:
Promptfoo is an AI security platform built to identify vulnerabilities in AI applications during development. The company describes itself as trusted by 156 of the Fortune 500 and more than 300,000 developers worldwide, with customers spanning healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and enterprise software.

The company's core product, also called Promptfoo, is an open-source prompt testing and red-teaming tool. It uses declarative YAML test cases with deterministic assertions and LLM-graded checks, and is designed to integrate into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing. The platform covers more than 50 vulnerability types, including prompt injection and jailbreaks, and is aimed at testing business logic, retrieval-augmented generation systems, agents, and third-party integrations rather than model-level evaluation alone.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
